questions.question: As per the third paragraph of the passage, what is the meaning of T - symmetry?
options: According to T-symmetry, a particle interaction that is advantageous in one direction when time moves forward should also be advantageous in the opposite direction when time moves forward.
According to T-symmetry, a particle interaction that is advantageous in one direction when time moves forward should also be advantageous in the opposite direction when time moves backward.
According to T-symmetry, a particle interaction that is disadvantageous in one direction when time moves forward should also be advantageous in the opposite direction when time moves backward.
According to T-symmetry, a particle interaction that is advantageous in one direction when time moves backward should also be advantageous in the same direction when time moves backward.
questions.explanation:
From the third paragraph of the passage, it is quite evident that T-symmetry means that a particle interaction in one direction that is favoured in forward time should be favoured in the reverse direction when time flows backwards.

Other options are not correct in context of the given passage.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.

  • Belittling is to put down or to make another person feel as though they aren’t important. 
  • Underestimate is to estimate as being less than the actual size, quantity or importance. 
  • Subduing is to reduce the force of something or prevent something from developing or existing.

So, with regard to the context of the passage, students are not able to “cope”, “manage”, or “survive” in these tough situations. Thus, among the given options, “cope” is the most appropriate word to fit into the blank (B). 

Hence, option (B) is the correct answer. 

Supplementary information:

  • Confront means to face or deal with a difficult situation or person. 
  • Disguise means to alter or change one’s identity or appearance in order to hide one’s true identity or truth.

questions.question: Which word will fill the given blank (3)?

So, the blank (3) must be filled up with a word similar to “argument”, “assertion” or “assumption” and among the options “contention” is the only word that means “an idea or an argument that is put forward in a discussion or debate.” 

Hence, option (C) is the correct answer. 

Supplementary information:

  • Controversy refers to a disagreement, debate or a dispute. 
  • Confrontation refers to a situation in which people or groups with opposing ideas or opinions disagree angrily.

questions.question: Which word will fill the given blank (4)?
questions.explanation:

As the passage talks about the “depressed” and “hopeless” students who can’t face difficult situations and ultimately attempt suicide, the blank must be filled with an adjective similar to “pessimistic”, “hopeless”, or “depressing”. Among the given options, “despairing” which means “hopeless, discouraging, negative” is the most appropriate adjective that can be used to describe such individuals. 

Hence, option (C) is the correct answer. 

Supplementary information:

  • Pragmatic used to refer to a practical person, the one who is willing to see things as they really are and deal with them sensibly. 
  • Utopian means imagining excellent or ideal conditions or an ideal society or something that is practically not possible.

questions.question: Which word will fill the given blank (5)?

So, here, this idiom states the immense pressure on the students of such institutes.

questions.question: Which word will fill the given blank (6)?

So, “spare a thought” is an idiom that means “to consider or think about someone or something” and is most appropriate to use here. It is used to describe that “parents should consider or ‘spare a thought’ regarding the underlying cause behind the suicides of children”.

Here, the errors lie in the parts (D) and (E) of the sentence.

When practised at work, spirituality with its roots in purpose-seeking has (A)/ the potential to restore back ethical behaviour (B)/ and encourages the alignment of personal values with those (C)/ of the organisation, which directly impacts how many respect (D)/ and dignity co-workers feel from their superiors. (E)
questions.explanation:
Here, the error lies in the parts (B) and (D) of the sentence. 

In part (B) of the sentence, the usage of “back” with “restore” is incorrect. The word “restore” means “to bring something back into existence”. So, using “back” with “restore” causes redundancy, and “restore back” forms a pair of superfluous words. Thus, we need to omit “back” to make the sentence grammatically correct. 

In the part (D) of the sentence, 'many' is incorrect. It needs to be replaced with 'much' as “many” is used for countable nouns and “much” is used for uncountable nouns. Here, “respect” is an abstract noun. 

Hence, option (B) is the correct answer. 

The correct sentence is:

When practised at work, spirituality, with its roots in purpose-seeking, has the potential to restore ethical behaviour and encourage the alignment of personal values with those of the organisation, which directly impacts how much respect and dignity co-workers feel from their superiors.

Thump their desks, the ruling party members resoundingly (A)/ exhibited their confidence and turned (B)/ the no-confidence motion into an opportunity (C)/ to flex their muscles, announce their achievements (D)/ and proclaimed their impending victory in the 2024 polls. (E)
questions.explanation:
Here, the error lies in the parts (A) and (E) of the sentence. 

In the part (A) of the sentence, the usage of “thump” is incorrect. It needs to be replaced with its gerund form, “thumping”. In this context, “thumping” refers to an ongoing action of the ruling party members during the “no-confidence” motion. 

In the part (E) of the sentence, the use of “proclaimed” is incorrect due to the error of “parallelism of verbs” i.e. the verbs or any part of speech in a sentence should be in the same grammatical form. Here, the verbs following “to” in part (D) are in the infinitive form “to+V1”. Thus, the verb “proclaimed” needs to be replaced with its infinitive form i.e. “proclaim” to maintain the parallelism with other verbs “flex” and “announce”.  

Hence, option (A) is the correct answer. 

The correct sentence is:

Thumping their desks, the ruling party members resoundingly exhibited their confidence and turned the no-confidence motion into an opportunity to flex their muscles, announce their achievements and proclaim their impending victory in the 2024 polls.

questions.question: A boat takes equal time to travel a distance of 81 km in upstream and 99 km in downstream. If the speed of the boat in still water is 20km/h, then what is the speed of the current (in km/h)?
questions.explanation:
Calculations:

Let the speed of the current be x km/h
According to the question,
81/(20 – x) = 99/(20 + x)
9/(20 – x) = 11/(20 + x)
180 + 9x = 220 – 11x
20x = 40
x = 2
Hence, the speed of current = 2 km/h.

Alternate Method:

Given:
Boat speed in still water = B = 20 km/h
Upstream distance = 81 km
Downstream distance = 99 km
Time upstream = Time downstream
Step 1: Shortcut formula
Speed of current = (Downstream distance – Upstream distance) ÷ (Downstream distance + Upstream distance) × Boat speed
Step 2: Substitute numbers
Speed of current = (99 – 81) ÷ (99 + 81) × 20
= 18 ÷ 180 × 20
= 0.1 × 20 = 2 km/h
Answer: Speed of current = 2 km/h
